chapter.title: Act III: The Harvest Debt
subtitle: Autumn, Year One
Fill the granary and finish Josie's storage system before winter — and feed the whole town at the Harvest Supper.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

quests.title: Take Oda's Token to the Store Counter
quests.subtitle: She counts the whole town's stores out loud.
description: Oda: "Four hundred and ten days of grain for fifteen people is one hundred and twelve days short of March. I have checked it twice."
Take Oda's token to her counter at the store and stand there while she counts the whole town's stores out loud.
It opens the winter checklist, the granary blueprint, and both lanes of autumn work.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"Twelve alcoves in the granary shell. Twelve drawers. Nobody is going hungry on my arithmetic.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The ledger is open
rewards.description: Next: twelve drawers into the granary's twelve alcoves, and the autumn seed pack into the marked beds.

quests.title: Fill the Granary's Twelve Alcoves
quests.subtitle: One drawer per alcove, at the Lantern Float.
description: Oda: "The shell went up at the Lantern Float: twelve alcoves, twelve drawers. Do not improvise on me."
Put one Oak Storage Drawer into each of the twelve marked alcoves in the granary at the Lantern Float, then tick this. Any order is right.
The drawers arrive already holding the town's current stock, and the Granary Waystone goes up outside the door.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"The key's brass. My initials are scratched off it and yours are scratched on. Don't lose it.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Granary stocked
rewards.description: Next: Marnie has the autumn seed pack — pumpkin, beetroot, oats and barley into the marked beds.

quests.title: Sow the Four Autumn Crops
quests.subtitle: Marked beds behind the inn.
description: Marnie: "Pumpkin, beetroot, oats and barley. Everything else is finished for the year, love, and arguing with it won't feed anybody."
Plant 4 Pumpkin Seeds, 4 Beetroot Seeds, 4 Oat Seeds and 4 Barley Seeds in the four marked beds behind the inn. Any order is right.
It pays out the larder crate — eggs, sugar, milk, meat, apples and twelve empty jars — which is everything the preserving work needs.

rewards.title: Autumn sown
rewards.description: Next: Halden is waiting at the hedge garden gate to walk you up to the spring.

quests.title: Fill Three Bottles at the Spring
quests.subtitle: Above the hedge garden, with Halden.
description: Halden: "There's a spring above the hedge garden, and Josie used it for the quartz, not the tea. I'll walk up with you."
Follow Halden to the spring above the hedge garden and fill 3 bottles of Spring Water there.
Spring Water is what grows certus quartz, which is the tech lane's next gate — and Josie's jar of sixteen crystals has been on Halden's shelf for four years.

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"She left the jar with me. I never asked what for. I think I knew.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Spring Water bottled
rewards.description: Next: Marnie's crate by the counter — 4 pies, 4 jams and 4 jars of pickles.

quests.title: Put Up Twelve Preserves
quests.subtitle: Cookbook pages 3 to 5.
description: Marnie: "Four pies, four jams, four jars of pickles — pages three to five. Everything you need is in the crate by the counter."
Make 4 Apple Pies, 4 Berry Jam Jars and 4 sealed Jars of pickles, and bring all twelve to the inn counter.
Bram left a fridge blueprint on that counter. It needs power, and he says he's working on it, which from Bram is a promise.

rewards.title: Larder stocked
rewards.description: Next: the inn kitchen — 4 loaves, 2 pies and 2 cakes. Halden's drying rack is in your pack for later.

quests.title: Bake 4 Bread, 2 Chocolate Pies and 2 Cakes
quests.subtitle: In the inn kitchen, off one heat.
description: Marnie: "Four loaves, two pies, two cakes. If you bank the oven right you'll get the lot out of one heat."
Bake 4 Bread, 2 Chocolate Pies and 2 Cakes in the inn kitchen.
It stocks the inn for the Supper, opens Pip's courier board, and it is half of what lets Halden read the Plate.

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Marnie: ","color":"light_purple"},{"text":"That's the first full oven since Josie. Don't tell Oda, she'll want it written down.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The oven is full
rewards.description: Next: Pip has three parcels on the counter and is already shouting about them.

quests.title: Run Three of Pip's Parcels
quests.subtitle: Named, sorted and urgent, apparently.
description: Pip: "This one's HENRIETTA, this one's THE BIG ONE, and this one is for Nella so you should probably run."
Deliver 3 of Pip's Courier Parcels to the addresses chalked on them.
It gets you the courier satchel, and Pip draws you. You are mostly hat.

rewards.title: Three parcels delivered
rewards.description: Next: hang 8 Smoked Ham on Josie's drying rack in the shed behind the inn.

quests.title: Cure Eight Hams on the Rack
quests.subtitle: The shed behind the inn.
description: Marnie: "Eight on the rack in the shed — salt, air and a week. No cleverness required, which is why I like it."
Hang 8 Smoked Ham on Josie's drying rack in the shed behind the inn, then tick this.
Thirty-two cured meat goes straight into the granary and the larder is closed for the year. The Nether stays shut until this act ends; you don't need it.

tasks.title: Eight hams hung on the rack.

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Marnie: ","color":"light_purple"},{"text":"That's meat in February. I have not been able to say that sentence in nine years.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The larder is closed
rewards.description: Next: the two upstairs bedrooms at the inn. Bed, rug, lantern and chest on each marked spot.

quests.title: Fit Out the Two Guest Rooms
quests.subtitle: Everything is in the packet.
description: Marnie: "Two rooms upstairs, both bare: a bed, a rug, a lantern and a chest in each. It's all in the packet."
Put a bed, a rug, a lantern and a chest on each of the eight marked spots across the inn's two upstairs bedrooms. Any order is right.
Two rooms Marnie can rent — and a letter arrives from the first person who wants one.

tasks.title: Both rooms furnished: bed, rug, lantern and chest on every marked spot.

rewards.title: Two rooms to let
rewards.description: Next: Wisp is downstream at the marsh beds — 12 rice, all ripe on the same day.

quests.title: Bring Wisp Twelve Marsh Rice
quests.subtitle: The marked plants downstream.
description: Wisp: "Downstream is many rice and they are ready all on the same day, which is rude of them, but good for us!"
Harvest 12 Rice from the marked plants downstream and hand them to Wisp at the reed village.
Wisp pays in rare marsh seed and the whole frog-village decor set — and the Ribbits start coming up to town.

rewards.title: Marsh harvest in
rewards.description: Next: Nella is on the pier. Eight fillets salted into the granary before the lake turns.

quests.title: Salt Eight Fillets into the Granary
quests.subtitle: Eight Cooked Fish Fillets into the granary drawers.
description: Nella: "Eight fillets, salted, straight into the granary drawers. Ice fishing works too, but this is the easy way round."
Catch fish off the pier, cure 8 Cooked Fish Fillets from them, and put all eight in the granary drawers.
That's fish in the granary and a salt barrel on the pier — one of the four things the Harvest Supper is waiting on.

rewards.title: Fish in the granary
rewards.description: Next: the long table. Twelve place settings and the centrepiece, once the cellar is open.

quests.title: Dig Out Tobin's Adit
quests.subtitle: About 90 marked blocks in the hillside.
description: Tobin: "Three cores, all copper-rich, all the same seam — so it isn't a pocket, it's a run. I've marked about ninety blocks, give or take."
Take Tobin's 3 core samples to the marked hillside, dig out the adit — roughly 90 marked blocks — and open the Lootr chest at the back.
The chest holds Josie's Kettle Plate. Hold on to it: Halden is the one who can read it, and that quest opens once the bakery line is done.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"Copper, iron, gold AND silver, all in one run, and I'm going to talk about it for a week.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The adit is open
rewards.description: Next: build a Thermal Induction Smelter at the mill and alloy 8 bronze and 8 electrum.

quests.title: Alloy Eight Bronze, Eight Electrum
quests.subtitle: Build the Induction Smelter first.
description: Bram: "Smelter takes two inputs and a dust: copper and tin for bronze, gold and silver for electrum. That's the whole machine."
Build a Thermal Induction Smelter in the mill workshop, then hold 8 Bronze Ingots and 8 Electrum Ingots.
It pays out the Centrifugal Separator, 64 Fluxduct and 2 spare Machine Frames — the entire bill for the energy cell and the rail line.

rewards.title: Alloys running
rewards.description: Next: charge a Thermal Energy Cell off the dynamos and run Fluxduct to the inn.

quests.title: Run Fluxduct to the Inn
quests.subtitle: Cell on the wall, duct to Marnie's kitchen.
description: Bram: "Cell on the wall, duct to the inn, and Marnie gets her fridge. That's the whole job — don't overthink it."
Charge a Thermal Energy Cell off your dynamos, then run Fluxduct from the mill until the line ends within 12 blocks of the inn.
That's the Works Power Tap: the Fridge, the Sink and the Milk Jar become craftable, and one is in this payout already.

tasks.title: Fluxduct reaches within 12 blocks of the inn.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Bram: ","color":"gray"},{"text":"Fridge works. Told her I was working on it.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The inn has power
rewards.description: Next: a Create train station at the mill and 64 track laid to the square.

quests.title: Lay the Line to the Square
quests.subtitle: Mill to square, station included.
description: Bram: "Station at the mill, track to the square, and sixty-four track and the station are in the packet. Don't curve it more than you have to."
Place 1 Create Train Station at the mill and lay 64 Track from it to the town square.
The engine and two cars come pre-made, and Oda's wagon can finally reach the store.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"There is a TRAIN. In the valley. I'm going to need everyone to stop and acknowledge that.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The line is live
rewards.description: Next: Oda's Delivery Crate is sitting in the station chest. Unload it.

quests.title: Unload Oda's Wagon
quests.subtitle: The crate is in the station chest.
description: Oda: "One crate, forty-one items. I signed for every one of them and I would like them counted again at this end."
Take the Delivery Crate out of the station chest in the square and open it at Oda's counter.
It opens Oda's catalogue tier three — the full decor list, seeds and animals, all buyable with Valley Scrip.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"Forty-one of forty-one. That is the first delivery this valley has taken in nine years. Shop's open properly now.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Oda's counter, tier three
rewards.description: Next: plant Certus Quartz Seeds in Halden's Spring Water and grow 32 certus.

quests.title: Grow Thirty-Two Certus in Spring Water
quests.subtitle: Josie's jar starts the first batch.
description: Halden: "She kept that jar on my shelf for four years and told me I'd know when. I know when."
Plant Certus Quartz Seeds in Halden's Spring Water and grow 32 Certus Quartz Crystals. The 16 from Josie's jar seed the first batch immediately.
Thirty-two certus is exactly the drive, two cells and terminal the next quest asks for.

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"The compass is already pointing. She set it. I only carried it.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Certus growing
rewards.description: Next: an ME Drive, 2 storage cells and a terminal in the mill workshop.

quests.title: Build the First ME Terminal
quests.subtitle: Drive, two cells, terminal — mill workshop.
description: Bram: "One box that knows what's in every other box. I don't like it and I'm going to use it constantly."
Build 1 ME Drive, 2 Item Storage Cells (4k) and 1 ME Terminal, and set them up in the mill workshop.
It pays out four more cells and the full bus set, which is what busses the granary onto the network.

rewards.title: The network is up
rewards.description: Next: storage-bus the granary's twelve drawers onto it.

quests.title: Bus the Granary onto the Network
quests.subtitle: Twelve drawers on one screen.
description: Oda: "If I can see all twelve drawers from the counter, I will stop walking down there four times a day. Do it."
Put a Storage Bus on the granary's drawer controller, link it to the mill network, and hold a Wireless Terminal that reads the whole town's stock.
Two wireless terminals come back — one for you, one to hand your partner — and Oda's ledger updates itself in the book from here on.

tasks.title: The granary's drawers read on the terminal.

rewards.title: One screen, whole town
rewards.description: Next: a Delivery Crate beside Oda's bounty board, fed by an export bus.

quests.title: Stand Up the Order Board
quests.subtitle: Crate beside Oda's board, export bus pointed at it.
description: Oda: "Standing orders: bread, planks, nails, lamp oil. If the crate is full when somebody walks up, nobody waits on me."
Place a Delivery Crate beside Oda's bounty board in the square and point an ME Export Bus at it with the town's standing orders patterned in.
Every delivery and every "bring X to Y" quest from here on is already filled when you walk up to it.

tasks.title: Delivery Crate placed beside the board and fed by the export bus.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"The crate fills itself. I have opinions about that, and all of them are good.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Standing orders live
rewards.description: Next: take the Kettle Plate from the adit to Halden at his cottage.

quests.title: Take the Plate to Halden
quests.subtitle: He can read Josie's shorthand.
description: Halden: "I've been able to read that hand for four years. I'm going to read it now, and then we're going down to your cellar."
Bring the Kettle Plate from the adit to Halden at his cottage and put it in his hands.
The iron door under your farmhouse turns a quarter and stops. Journal Part Two opens, and the Bigger Reactors recipes appear — casings still need Josie's Turbine Notes.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"It's a parts list. It has always been a parts list. She wasn't digging a mine.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The door turns a quarter
rewards.description: Next: go down into the cellar under the farmhouse and read the wall.

quests.title: Read the Cellar Wall
quests.subtitle: Down the stairs under the farmhouse.
description: Josie, in chalk, in her own hand: "A machine that one person can run is not infrastructure — it's a hostage. So I shut it off and I waited for two of you."
Go down the stairs under the farmhouse and stand in front of the cellar wall until you have read the whole thing.
The Works Waystone goes in, her steel toolbox is on the bench, and her original reactor blueprint is yours to hang.

tasks.title: You are standing in the cellar, in front of the wall.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Josie, on the wall: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"If there's more than one set of footprints on my cellar stairs, then I was right to wait. Go and turn it on.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The Works was a power plant
rewards.description: Next: the long table in the square — twelve place settings and the centrepiece. That's the Harvest Supper.

quests.title: Set the Long Table for Twelve
quests.subtitle: Act III finale — twelve settings and one centrepiece.
description: Marnie: "Twelve places: nobody stands, nobody eats in the kitchen, and nobody eats alone. That's the rule tonight."
Place the Long Table in the square, put 1 Place Setting on each of the twelve marked spots, and set the Candle Holder in the middle. Any order is right.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.
Sit down. The granary's full, the lamps are lit down the road, and every single person this valley has is at this table.

tasks.title: Twelve settings down and the centrepiece in the middle.

rewards.title: The Harvest Supper
rewards.description: Next: sleep one night, then follow Pip down to the inn. Winter starts in the morning.
